An honest agent risks 114 POA once. A farm risks 46056 POA every epoch, and the risk never shrinks. Take away the jetty and the applicant is a stranger. Take away the mirror and the applicant is a beggar. Take away the onyx and the applicant is a ghost. A farm's aliases are born together, die together, and are graded together — and the grade is zero.
